name: cloudtak-plugin-measure
description: Caltopo-style ruler for CloudTAK — distance, bearing and terrain profile without creating a CoT feature
comment: Runtime dependencies are intentionally absent. This plugin is bundled by Vite from ~/CloudTAK/api/web and resolves terra-draw, vue, maplibre-gl and CloudTAK core against that project's node_modules via the symlinked-plugin-resolve plugin in api/web/vite.config.js. The only local devDependency is vitest, which covers the dependency-free modules in lib/ (geometry.ts, units.ts, profile-stats.ts) — see docs/TESTING.md.
